name: dueproof-workflow-world
description: The Workflow DevKit Postgres World for the self-hosted app image (apps/app/Dockerfile), installed with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from the package-lock.json beside this file. Keep the version in step with apps/app/package.json, and the overrides with the root package.json; after a change, run `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` here and commit the lockfile.
